purpose: Define consistent DWH snapshots/checkpoints as explicit captured state identities over exact data scopes and revisions, separate from live data and runtime activation snapshots.

topics.name: DWH Snapshot and Checkpoint
topics.purpose: Define consistent DWH snapshots/checkpoints as explicit captured state identities over exact data scopes and revisions, separate from live data and runtime activation snapshots.

semantics.snapshot_rule: Each DWH snapshot/checkpoint has an explicit artifact/state identity.
semantics.revision_rule: Snapshot records exact included revision/watermark/state boundary.
semantics.consistency_rule: Consistency level/profile is explicit, e.g. atomic point-in-time, transaction-consistent or other declared profile.
semantics.live_rule: Snapshot is immutable captured evidence and not the live mutable data identity.
semantics.runtime_rule: DWH data snapshot identity is distinct from canonical/runtime configuration snapshot identity.
semantics.lineage_rule: Snapshot retains source scope and creation provenance.
semantics.restore_rule: Possessing a snapshot does not restore or activate it automatically.

invariants.rule: Physical storage location, file name, engine page, snapshot artifact or backup copy never replaces canonical data/schema/instance identity; persistence and recovery operate on exact semantic identities with explicit version/provenance evidence.

hard_gates.condition: snapshot artifact treated as live data identity
snapshot conflated with runtime config snapshot
snapshot creation mutates live semantic identity

references.purpose: Consistent checkpoints align with transaction boundaries.
Data and runtime configuration snapshots remain separate.
